This site uses workforcenow-adp.com which is suspicious. Although the page is served over HTTPS, the unusual domain structure, potential for phishing/impersonation, and mismatch with the known vendor domain are red flags for handling high-sensitivity PII (bank account/routing, SSN, card number, passwords). According to the hard-stop rules, do NOT submit any sensitive personal information here.
